summary: Turkcell filed a Form 6-K (the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report) disclosing that its board resolved to inject USD 7,000,000 and/or the FX equivalent into subsidiary CJSC Belarusian Telecommunications Network (BeST) as a capital increase, with USD 5,000,000 funded in October 2026 and USD 2,000,000 in December 2026. No stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine intra-group subsidiary capital injection, not a special situation; watch only for BeST funding/impairment or disclosure risk.
